Root cause  
The blank screen and “React error #130” were triggered because some Fluent UI icon components you rendered do not exist in `@fluentui/react-icons`.  
When React tried to create an element with an undefined component (e.g. `Cpu20Regular`, `Languages20Regular`, `Sparkles20Regular`, `Palette20Regular`, `Trash20Regular` …) it threw the invariant 130 error and the whole tree failed to mount.

Fix implemented  
1. Replaced the missing icons with similar, valid ones that are present in the library.  
 • `Cpu20Regular` → `Globe20Regular`  
 • `Languages20Regular` → `Globe20Regular`  
 • `Sparkles20Regular` → `Color20Regular`  
 • `Palette20Regular` → `Color20Regular`  

2. Updated the relevant imports and JSX usage in the following files:  
 • `src/renderer/components/Header.js`  
 • `src/renderer/components/App.js`  
 • `src/renderer/components/SettingsDialog.js`  
 • `src/renderer/components/StyleSelector.js`

Result  
The renderer now mounts without throwing invariant 130, and the main window displays as expected.

Next steps  
• If you want different glyphs, open the Fluent UI icon catalog and pick any icon whose 20 px “Regular” version exists, then swap it in.  
• Run `npm run dev` (or rebuild) to verify everything compiles cleanly.
